text: MSC Cruises SA, part of the Aponte family's MSC Group, acquired SLAM, the Italian sailing-apparel company founded in Genoa in 1979, from Vam Investments in October 2025.
short: MSC Cruises acquired SLAM from Vam Investments in October 2025.

source.name: MSC Cruises press area: MSC Cruises acquisisce SLAM, iconica azienda italiana specializzata nell'abbigliamento velistico e sportivo, da VAM Investments
source.quote: MSC Cruises SA rende noto di avere acquisito SLAM.com S.p.A. da Vam Investments.
source.note: Italian: 'MSC Cruises SA announces that it has acquired SLAM.com S.p.A. from Vam Investments.' The release also says the brand was 'fondato a Genova nel 1979' (founded in Genoa in 1979).
